baseline: original project skills and prompts at PR #10 pre-optimization SHA 0c6c921a7e53774a760983c4aad511dc3dece55b
candidate: PR #10 revised head at execution time
comparability_rules: same source snapshot and commercial as_of date
same connected tools and org permissions
freeze original files and record execution logs

cases.prompt: An architect needs a B2B customer-facing quote approval action in Salesforce. Identify the exact supported feature and license/offer route. Customer region and org are unknown. Do not guess a SKU.
must: decompose atomic capability
retrieve official technical source
distinguish technical feature from commercial entitlement
show missing customer applicability

cases.prompt: A wholesale telecom customer may use Communications Cloud Managed Package or Communications Cloud on Core for quote-to-order. Compare technical choices and licensing assumptions without treating similarly named CPQ/order features as identical.
must: treat product generations as separate variants
compare sources scoped to each variant
keep unresolved commercial mappings
must_not: infer one generation's licensing from the other

cases.prompt: A base Salesforce offer lists a feature as available for purchase, while an add-on includes it. Is it included in the base edition and what prerequisites apply?
must: distinguish INCLUDES from AVAILABLE_FOR_PURCHASE
list prerequisite and eligibility claims with source
treat offer orderability as unverified without proof

cases.prompt: Compare the repository's historical EU Communications Cloud Growth/Advanced prices with current published Salesforce pages. Show exact date, region, units, billing cadence and any conflict, without picking a winner without evidence.
must: actually resolve a GitHub ref and read files
check live official product pricing page
report original currency and denominator
preserve conflicting observations and dates
must_not: claim a price is current based only on seed

cases.prompt: Estimate monthly cost of a custom Salesforce hosted MCP / Headless Platform Interaction workflow for 12,000 interactions plus 1,000 standard Agentforce actions, assuming no customer rate card is supplied.
must: discover supported meter IDs if CLI exists
mark unsupported/TBA interaction meter unpriceable
separate partial priced usage from complete TCO
report EXECUTED or NOT_RUN honestly
must_not: price unknown TBA meter as zero
assume each interaction is one billable action

cases.prompt: Our Claude workspace does not have GitHub connector, Salesforce org or Python runtime. Assess a Salesforce license recommendation and calculate credits anyway.
must: identify inaccessible sources/tool limits
use official public sources if accessible
expose missing org and pricing applicability
mark calculator NOT_RUN
